_설명: 탑20 롱폼 「준비와 당일」 편의 장면 사양(가로 16:9, 1920×1080). 기획은 docs/video/top20-longform-prep-plan.md, 소리 글은 narration-prep.json(lines 의 숫자 = 그 파일 episodes.prep 의 줄 번호, 0부터). kind: clip(Veo 움직이는 컷) · still(정지 그림, 느린 확대·이동) · promise(얻는 것 세 가지) · title(장 제목) · check(장 요약 체크리스트) · recap(전체 정리) · end(끝 화면). p: person(뒷모습 한 사람, 기준 그림 참조) / object(사람·손 없음). cap 은 화면 자막이 소리 글과 다른 줄만 적는다(숫자 표기). 그림에는 글자·숫자·얼굴·손이 없어야 한다.
title: 혼주메이크업 준비 순서 총정리 | 예약 전부터 결혼식 당일 아침까지 체크리스트

cap.34: 전날 저녁은 7시 이전에 가볍게 드시고, 야식은 참아 주세요.
cap.54: 여기까지 체크. 저녁은 7시 전에 가볍게. 팩과 머리 감기는 전날 밤. 한복과 소품은 현관이나 차에.
cap.56: 메이크업 시작 1시간 전에, 스킨, 로션, 에센스를 넉넉하게 발라 흡수시켜 주세요.
cap.60: 혼주 화장은 최소 5시간 이상 유지돼야 하거든요.
cap.64: 로션과 에센스도 같은 방법으로, 2~3번씩 두드려 바르세요.
cap.65: 순서는 스킨, 로션, 에센스. 이 3가지만 바르고, 다른 제품은 바르지 마세요.
cap.70: 여기까지 체크. 1시간 전, 스킨 7번. 로션과 에센스까지 3가지만. 그리고 앞단추 옷.
cap.73: 상황에 따라 약간 가감은 있지만, 평균 여자 혼주 1시간 30분, 남자 혼주 30분 정도입니다.
cap.83: 여기까지 체크. 여자 혼주 1시간 30분, 남자 혼주 30분.
cap.92: 정답은 혼주메이크업 100문 100답, P6·02에 있습니다. 링크는 설명란에 있어요.

scenes.img: The entrance of an elegant small makeup salon seen from the street: a glass door with a brass handle, warm light inside, a potted olive tree and a bench beside the door. No signboard, no lettering on the glass.
scenes.m: The leaves of the potted tree move gently in a light breeze and the warm light inside glows softly.

scenes.img: A wedding hall lobby with a reception table covered in white cloth, a large flower arrangement, a guest book lying closed and soft chandelier light. Empty, calm, welcoming.

A round hand mirror lying face-down on a vanity next to an unused lipstick and a small wall clock with a completely blank face and two plain hands. A hanbok garment bag waits by the door in the background.

The woman seen from behind, seated at a small round consultation table in a salon, facing a softly lit plain wall with a shelf of brushes. On the table: an open blank notebook, a cup of tea and a makeup color palette.
scenes.m: A thin wisp of steam rises from the tea cup and she tilts her head very slightly as if listening.

scenes.img: Close view from behind of the woman's elegant low chignon with a small pearl hair ornament, the pale pink collar of her jeogori visible at the bottom, plain warm cream background.
An open blank notebook with a pen laid across it, a cup of tea, a fan of fabric color swatches and a few hairpins on a round table in warm afternoon light. The pages are empty.
A wedding ceremony aisle lined with white and pink flowers and candles under warm light, rows of empty chairs with ribbons on both sides.

scenes.m: Steam rises slowly from the cup and the thin curtain moves gently in the breeze.

scenes.m: Her goreum ribbon and skirt hem sway very slightly and soft light flickers on the flowers.

scenes.m: The thin curtain sways slowly and the sunset light shifts gently across the hanbok silk.

scenes.img: A bedside table at night with a softly glowing lamp, a warm cup of tea, a small bouquet and a blank cream envelope, a folded blanket at the edge of the bed.
A light early dinner on a wooden tray: a small bowl of rice porridge, two tiny side dishes, a spoon and chopsticks and a cup of water, early evening light from a window.
A calm bathroom corner: neatly folded white towels on a wooden stool, a bathrobe on a hook and gentle steam in warm light.
A dressing table at night by a window with a crescent moon: a plain unlabeled sheet mask pouch, a white sheet mask folded on a small dish, a jar of cream and a headband.
A white washbasin in bright morning light with a folded face towel, a bar of soap on a dish and a small cup, water drops on the porcelain.
A shower shelf at night: one plain unlabeled shampoo bottle, a wooden comb and a soft towel, with a dark window and a small moon behind.

The woman seen from behind seated in a salon chair with a white salon cape over her shoulders, her dark brown hair down, loose and slightly damp, facing a plain softly lit wall. A hair dryer and a curling iron rest on the counter beside her.
A hair dryer and a large round brush resting on a bathroom counter in early morning light, a dry folded towel beside them.
One plain shampoo bottle standing in front, a second plain bottle pushed far to the back edge of the shelf, and a small dish of U-shaped hairpins and bobby pins in the foreground.

A home entryway the night before a wedding: a hanbok garment bag and a dark suit garment bag hanging on a coat hook, a hanbok box wrapped in silk cloth on the bench, a small accessories bag and two pairs of formal shoes placed neatly by the door.
A men's silk necktie rolled neatly and a brown leather belt coiled beside it on a dresser top, with a folded white dress shirt and cufflinks in a small tray.
A freshly pressed pink and magenta hanbok left hanging on a hanger on a wardrobe door in an empty sunlit room at home, an ironing board folded against the wall.
scenes.m: Sunlight moves slowly across the hanbok and the long goreum ribbon stirs slightly in the air.
